message: The other day, as I was watching the weather report, I realized I was woefully unprepared for a storm. My emergency kit was basically an old flashlight, some expired granola bars, and a deck of cards. I chuckled at the thought of waiting out a hurricane with a game of solitaire! It’s funny how we often think we’re ready until reality hits. So, I made a list and took a little trip to the store to stock up. What’s the silliest thing you’ve found in your own emergency kit? 😄
